datasets.name: Bijie landslide detection database
datasets.verbatim: The Bijie dataset, introduced by Ji et al. (2020), encompasses the entire Bijie city, situated in the northwest region of Guizhou province, China, covering an expansive area of 26,853 km2.

datasets.name: Ludian and Beichuan regions landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Second, open-source data from the Ludian and Beichuan regions (Han et al., 2023) is utilized.

methods.name: Attention-integrated YOLOv8 network (YOLOv8 + CBAM, ECA, SA, and ResCBAM)
methods.summary: An enhanced YOLOv8 object detection network that incorporates attention modules (CBAM, ECA, and SA) and a residual block (ResCBAM) into the neck of the architecture to improve feature extraction and landslide detection accuracy.
methods.verbatim: The source code of the original YOLOv8 model is acquired from https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available. The custom code repository is not provided, as the paper only references the original YOLOv8 source code.
